extra.name: MTIMECMP_HI
extra.description: High word of the per-hart 64-bit machine timer comparator.

extra.name: LUT_WORD
extra.description: Two 16-bit instructions. Sequence n begins at word 4*n; PC7 must terminate or jump on CS. Bits 9:8 of each halfword are reserved.

fields.name: PADS0
fields.description: 0 = one pad, 1 = two pads, 2 = four pads; 3 is invalid.

fields.name: OPCODE0
fields.description: 0 STOP, 1 CMD, 2 ADDR, 3 MODE, 4 DUMMY, 5 TX, 6 RX, 7 JUMP_ON_CS.

fields.name: PADS1
fields.description: 0 = one pad, 1 = two pads, 2 = four pads; 3 is invalid.

fields.name: OPCODE1
fields.description: 0 STOP, 1 CMD, 2 ADDR, 3 MODE, 4 DUMMY, 5 TX, 6 RX, 7 JUMP_ON_CS.

extra.name: WORD
extra.description: AES key words; writes stage key material and reads are rejected with PSLVERR and return no secret material.

fields.name: DATA
fields.description: AES key words; writes stage key material and reads are rejected with PSLVERR and return no secret material.

extra.name: WORD
extra.description: AES chaining-state words, returned in the documented byte order.

extra.description: SHA digest words, most significant word first.

fields.name: DATA

fields.name: DATA

extra.name: WORD

fields.name: DATA

fields.name: ISOLATED
fields.description: Live target isolation status, not a counter snapshot.

fields.name: PRIORITY
fields.description: Priority 0 disables delivery; source 0 is reserved and hardwired zero.

extra.name: PENDING
extra.description: Pending sources; claim changes pending/claimed state.

fields.name: PENDING
fields.description: Bit n indicates pending source n. Source 0 remains zero.

extra.name: ENABLE
extra.description: Context source mask; context 0 is machine and context 1 supervisor.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Enable source n for this context. Source 0 cannot be enabled.

fields.name: THRESHOLD
fields.description: Only a source with priority strictly greater than this value is eligible.

extra.name: CLAIM_COMPLETE
extra.description: Claim and complete register; reads and writes have different side effects.

fields.name: SOURCE_ID
fields.description: Read claims the winning source, or zero if none. Write the nonzero claimed ID to complete it.
